data.name: Arctic Fox Virginia

Changes Virginia into an anthropomorphic / furry arctic fox, because

data.name: Sons of the Furrest
data.description:
Sons of the FURRest? Get it?
Yeah me neither.

Turns all players into furry/anthro characters. There are currently 5 species:
- Border Collie
- Red Fox
- Arctic Fox
- Canadian Lynx
- Whitetail Deer

Like with my last mods, I haven't tested on the latest version. Should work in multiplayer, at least it worked for me. Also seems to work in singleplayer I think.

It is compatible with the Race Selector mod, since my mod does some retarded checksum every 30 seconds to see if any races are updated. You can also press F3 to manually refresh every player's species model.

data.name: ForestTalk
data.shortDescription: Actually talk to Kelvin and Virginia. Kelvin, now deaf, still has plenty to say. Chat through his notepad or hit O for a quick shortcut. Give him real in-game orders. Deep customization included.
data.description:
ForestTalk turns Kelvin and Virginia into real companions, not silent bots you just watch.

💬 How to talk to them
With Kelvin, open his notepad and press T to type. You can also press O while nearby and looking at him, no notepad needed. Virginia works the same way: get close, look at her, and press O, if she's willing.

🧠 Kelvin, your companion
I put a lot of effort into making him aware of his surroundings: nearby danger, your state, the weather, what he's doing. This mod assumes the crash left him deaf, but he can still speak. He's not a bot you click through, he's your companion, and he'll always have something to say. Warm personality, a bit shaken by what he's been through, with a strong moral compass against the forest.

You can also give him real orders through chat: bring logs, repair the camp, build a fire, stay put, follow you, and more. Real orders he carries out in-game.

🌿 Virginia, an independent soul
Virginia can talk with you too, on her own terms: a fully independent person. She can't be given orders or commands, she'll only chat if she feels like it.

⚠️ Real environmental awareness
Both react to what's actually happening: danger, injuries, hunger or thirst, night, rain. I dug deep into the game's code so this isn't a chat bolted on top, they react to what's going on with you.

👀 Bonus: let them see what you see
Type !look plus your message (e.g. !look what do you think of our base?) to send a screenshot along with it. A fun little extra, not required. Heads up: capturing it pauses the game for a split second.

⚙️ Deep customization
Choose between several AI providers: Player2 (a button to generate your API key instantly), OpenAI, Gemini, OpenRouter, or your own custom/local server. Adjust how often they speak on their own, toggle danger comments, write custom personality notes, and more.

Surviving the forest is no longer something you do alone. Kelvin and Virginia become real friends to face the island with.

data.name: Character Select
data.shortDescription: Choose your player appearance and keep it across sessions. Works in multiplayer.
data.description:
Sons of the Forest gives you a random appearance every time you join a server, and there is no way to choose. This mod lets you pick the one you want and automatically reapplies it every time your player spawns, so you stay the same character.

Press F9 in game to cycle through the eight appearances. The current one is shown on screen as you cycle. Your choice is saved and applied automatically on every spawn.

If your keyboard has no F keys, or you would rather pick one directly, press F1 to open the console and use the CHARACTER command.

Client side only. Nothing needs to be installed on a dedicated server. Your appearance replicates through normal game networking, so other players see your choice even if they do not have the mod installed.

Source: https://github.com/JustinOros/sotf-character-select

data.name: Freshwater is Drinkable
data.shortDescription: Running water is safe (except when contaminated). Stagnant water is not.
data.description:
REQUIRES https://sotf-mods.com/mods/brutechiefton/uicoordinator


What to expect
--
Filling a flask or pot from a clean source will give you clean water. Drinking from a clean source will not make you sick, it will actually clear some sickness (just like clean/boiled water).

Doing the same at a dirty water source will still give you dirty water and make you sick as normal.

*Note: Only the water sources on the surface have been mapped. 


The mod works by querying against the water graph to find the nearest node. An unmapped water source will therefore use the nearest one, which may or may not not make sense. 


If this bothers you, please use the in-game editor (F7, add last target) to add a node and program it as desired.


Caves and their water sources are currently unmapped.*


Details
--
The mod comes with a water graph that I drew by hand. I marked all the rivers and streams as clean, and every stagnant pool/pond as dirty. 

Each new save's water graph will be loaded from this canonical graph. You can see and edit the water graph by pressing F7. 

Changes made will be saved when you save your game. Different saves can have different graphs.

To overwrite the default water graph, press export. 
To reload the default, press reload.

Dedicated server graphs cannot be edited at this time.

data.name: UICoordinator
data.shortDescription: Enable cursor when any menu is open. Disable when they're all closed.
data.description:
UICoordinator provides reference-counted ownership of menu input. While one or more mod menus hold a lease, UICoordinator unlocks and displays the cursor, places the game input system into menu mode, and suppresses mouse-look. When the final menu releases its lease, the previous cursor and input state are restored.

This prevents independent mod menus from fighting over the cursor or restoring gameplay input while another menu remains open.

Download and check out the readme if you'd like to use it for your own mods.

data.name: Knight V on Golf Carts
data.shortDescription: Allows you to place up to 3 Knight V's on a golf cart for easy transport.
data.description:
How to use
--
1. Pick up a Knight V
2. Try to get into a non-driver seat while holding the Knight V
3. Take it out by picking it up again normally


What to expect
--
While a seat contains a Knight V, it will be considered occupied.

Seat placement and attachment should survive save & reload.
